newsitem.title: USA: Wall Street stocks higher at start.
newsitem.headline: Wall Street stocks higher at start.

text.p: Wall Street stocks were higher with bonds at the start of trading on Wednesday, extending a bounce which started at the end of last week.
The Dow Jones industrial average was up 10 at 6,619, the Nasdaq Composite seven higher at 1,265 and the S&P Index up one at 767.
The 30-year long bond was up 7/32 to yield 7.08 percent.
